fact: The ministerial circular states that the 2024 general State budget will be entirely executed in SIGFiP, centrally and in deconcentrated services, and that expenditure may only be initiated and executed there, with taxpayer IDs checked in E-Tax.
title: Circulaire portant instructions relatives à l'exécution du Budget Général de l'Etat pour l'exercice 2024
publisher: Ministère des Finances et du Budget, Tchad
